text:
Type: two-tone stoneware planter
Use: holding a small indoor plant; on a shelf, desk or windowsill; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: glossy glazed stoneware top, matte bottom band
Colors: white, dark slate grey
Shape: short straight cylinder, color-blocked lower band, small recessed foot, compact
Feel: clean, simple, fresh
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey textiles; Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century 2-Toned Stoneware Planter, 4.13"H, Gray and White
product.description: Add elegance to your room with this attractive 2-toned stoneware planter. With its simple gray-and-white design, this planter is an ideal accent for mid-century or modern-minimalist home decor, and it’s charming whether holding a plant or displayed empty. 5.12" diameter x 4.13"H 100% stoneware Bring this durable stoneware planter to life with colorful flowers, or use it as a simple home-decor piece. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
